title: Verify outputs line
description: One line of the outputs blob of VerifyRun and of the corpus blob of VerifyGenerate and VerifyGenerateAndCheck (the candidates): JSON lines, one object per task, ordered by index, outputs verbatim. Byte-identical for a taskset, as long as every node did its work and told the truth. A task the nodes could not settle (NoResult, Disputed) has a line too, with empty stdout and stderr.

verdict.description: A verdict name of the report (verify-report.schema.json), NoResult and Disputed included.

exit.description: Exit code; -1 for a task without an accepted result.

reason.description: Present only for NoResult: why the task has no result, as in the report.

stdout.description: What the program printed, up to the task's stdout cap. For a task with a suite, the last case's stdout.

stdout_truncated.description: Present only when stdout hit its cap. Nothing past the cap is kept: the write that passes it ends the run.

stderr_truncated.description: Present only when stderr hit its cap. What came after was dropped, and the run went on.

cases.description: Present when the task has a suite: one entry per case, in suite order, each with its own stdout. The task's own stdout is then the last case's.

stdout.description: What the program printed in this case. The cases of a task share its stdout cap: a case keeps what the cases before it left, and one that prints after the cap is spent keeps nothing and is OutputExceeded.
